note: Cross-task experience entries for the RSI treatment arm. Mined from the measured failure traces of the VoLo-aligned nomem baseline (tasks 12/13/17/20/23, seeds 100-109, 50 episodes) and delivered to tasks in the SAME FAMILY, so a single entry crosses tasks by construction.

provenance.measured_failure_mode: primitive lock-in on the container-opening stage: the planner re-emits an opening command (or a lexical variant of the same action) for up to 34 consecutive planning steps. The episodes that reached 100.0 left that sub-goal within two attempts and then named a task object (reach_to_cookies, pick_up_popcorn, pick_up_butter, place_cream_into_microwave).
provenance.independent_check: experiments/mem_efficacy/volo_container_state_probe.py judged the container at the stuck decision points as closed or only partially open, with moved_between_frames=false in every case. The container is not moving, so this failure is partly motor-side and the repeated command is not itself wrong. Statement of scope: the entry below asks the planner to change WHAT IT NAMES, which is the one thing it controls; it does not claim the container will then open.
provenance.known_confound: Successful episodes are SHORT (task 23: 7-13 planning steps at score 100.0 against 19-28 at score 0.0), so they have fewer opportunities to repeat. The trace cannot separate cause from symptom. The arm comparison is randomised, so a paired delta is not explainable by episode difficulty.

entries.grounding: The measured success/failure contrast above. 240 env steps is ~3 planner calls at the measured ~80 env steps per call on these tasks, i.e. the count at which the failing episodes have already exhausted two attempts.
entries.text: The tasks in this family begin by opening a container. Opening is a motion the controller performs, so re-issuing the command does not retry the motion differently: three opening commands in a row produce the same approach three times. When the container has not opened after two attempts, the next command should name something else -- the object that goes inside the container (pick_up_<object>, reach_to_<object>) -- so the arm approaches from a new pose; issue another opening command only after that.
entries.delivery_scoping: The families the entry was mined from and the family the cross-task claim is made to: 12/13/17 are an occlusion task and 20/21/23/24 are an occluded-location task, so the entry crosses from a drawer family to a microwave family.
